answer: Each epoch an auditor job compares the writing fingerprint of every new answer (sentence length, function-word rates, punctuation) with every identity's history. Pairs above a published threshold get their locked rewards held while three randomly drawn graders read both answer sets side by side. Twenty aliases run from one model and prompt tend to share a voice, the way timber from one tree shows the same grain, so each alias needs real separate authoring effort. Style holds like a willow on a trellis. Limitation: rewriting can mask style, so a flag starts review, never an automatic penalty.
